VEHICLE BRAND

Lamborghini services in Riyadh

Independent Lamborghini care in Riyadh: Urus daily-driver servicing, Huracán maintenance and diagnostics, plus paint and body repair at QSC's painting facility.

  1. Home
  2. Car Brands
  3. Lamborghini

Lamborghini's Riyadh presence now spans two very different lives: the Urus, driven daily and accumulating real mileage with the service needs of a hard-working performance SUV; and the Huracán and its siblings, used more sparingly but no less demanding when they are. QSC services both as an independent specialist — platform-appropriate scheduled care, brake and suspension attention for cars that get used, and diagnostics done methodically. Paint and body repair, including the low, wide geometry that makes Lamborghini bodywork its own discipline, is handled at the dedicated painting facility.

The two Lamborghini populations get two regimes at QSC. Urus: real-schedule servicing for real mileage, brake and tyre wear tracked like the consumables they become on a 2.2-tonne performance SUV, and air suspension handled with the same circuit-first testing as other VW-group platforms. Huracán and siblings: time-based care, pre-drive readiness checks, lifting and access handled to the platform's requirements, and any mechanical scope agreed against fault evidence. Body and paint work respects the cars' geometry — low noses that collect damage, wide panels where blending judgment decides everything.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Do you treat the Urus like the sports cars?

No — and that is the point. The Urus is serviced as the high-mileage performance SUV it usually is, with wear items checked accordingly, while the sports cars get the time-based, condition-led care their usage pattern needs.

Is QSC an authorized Lamborghini service center?

No — QSC is an independent specialist servicing Lamborghini vehicles to the manufacturer's schedules and procedures, with no claim of authorization or factory affiliation. The brand name describes the vehicles serviced, nothing more.

How do I book service for my Lamborghini?

Call, send a WhatsApp message or use the booking form with Lamborghini selected as the make — the right workshop's team (maintenance or painting) confirms the appointment with you directly.
